summary: Frontend retest of Owner-PIN flows for manager & admin PASSED. All previously failing scenarios (manager Refer & Earn, manager Reports commission, manager unlock-rate) now work. Admin regression also passes. Note: React.StrictMode is enabled in dev, causing the PIN modal to appear twice (double-invoke of useEffect) on Refer & Earn and Reports/staff-commission — user has to submit PIN twice in dev preview. In production build StrictMode does not double-invoke, so this is DEV-ONLY. Not a functional bug but a UX annoyance in dev preview.

ui_bugs.issue: React.StrictMode causes double useEffect invocation in dev → two stacked owner-pin modals on Refer & Earn (and staff-commission on Reports). User must submit PIN twice in the preview environment. Works in production build. Consider guarding pinApi requests or dismissing already-shown modal when a new PIN request comes in.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Deduplicate concurrent PIN prompts in /app/frontend/src/lib/ownerPin.js so simultaneous 403 responses share a single askPin() promise (avoids double-modal on Refer & Earn and Reports in dev/StrictMode).
Existing 'Failed to load resource: 401' at /login is expected (unauthenticated /me probe) — safe to ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: ownerPin.js does not coalesce parallel PIN prompts — if two API calls 403 simultaneously (e.g., due to StrictMode or intentional parallel calls), two overlays stack. Fix: share a single in-flight askPin() promise.
Reports.jsx load() fires two independent try/catch API calls in useEffect; combined with StrictMode this produces 2x staff-commission → 2x PIN modal in dev.
